description_sq:
Shitet apartament 3+1 ne nje kompleks cilesor tek 5-Maji!
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje sallon te bollshem me ballkon, nje korridor qe realizon shperndarjen e dhomave te gjumit, 3 dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete.
Kompleksi eshte ne faze perfundimtare punimesh.
Mundesi blerje per post parkimi me cmim ekstra.
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in a quality complex at 5-Maji! The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with a balcony, a corridor that distributes the bedrooms, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The complex is in the final stage of works. Possibility of purchasing a parking post at an extra price.
